decisions.why: the row's own examples are the Static Air Hz product images plus 'C18509 Hz Spec Sheet' - Dyna Form is the mattress-replacement brand and Static Air Hz is a static-air mattress system; the stray 'Air Pro Plus Alternating Cushion 3' image is a crawler artefact, not the product of this URL segment
the four 'products' are image files of one product; Jupiter is a Dyna Form mattress-replacement model, sitting with Mercury, Saturn and Maximus in the same planet-named mattress family
the three 'products' are image files of one product; Saturn follows the Dyna Form planet-named mattress family (Mercury, Jupiter, Maximus), all mattress replacements
the five 'products' are image files of one product; Maximus is a Dyna Form mattress-replacement model

the images are of the Dyna Form Mercury Fire Evac, a foam pressure-care bed mattress with evacuation straps built into it; it is a mattress first, so it sits with the rest of the Dyna Form Mercury mattress range rather than with evacuation aids

the two 'Proformance 300X294' images are of the ProFormance cover fabric used on the Dyna Form mattress range - a mattress cover technology, consistent with Dyna Form Vapour Flow already mapped handling:mattress

the seven 'products' are image files of one product; Dyna Tek is the pressure-cushion brand (Dyna Tek Pad Cushion, Gel Cushion and Intelligent Air Cushion are all mapped handling:cushion) and Superior is a cushion model in it
the four 'products' are image files of one product; Owl is a cushion model under the Dyna Tek pressure-cushion brand
the three 'products' are image files of one product; Posture Visco is a visco-elastic seat cushion under the Dyna Tek cushion brand
the three 'products' are image files of one product; Profile is a cushion model under the Dyna Tek cushion brand
the eight 'products' are image files of one product; this URL segment is the G-2 Tilt-in-Space Specialist Seat, a dynamic tilt-in-space chair, matching wheelchairs and specialist seating
the five 'Encora' images are of one product, the Encora tilt-in-space specialist seating chair (back recline, tilt-in-space), matching specialist seating

the two 'Stirling Main' images are of one product, the Stirling Specialist Seat - an armchair on castors with seat ramp and back recline, consistent with the Wendover and Chatsworth riser recliners already mapped rehab:chair

the 'Proaxis50_35Rl' images are of one product; the Pro Axis range is a bariatric riser recliner sold at these seat widths and safe working loads, so specialist seating, consistent with the Wendover/Chatsworth riser recliners already mapped rehab:chair
the 'Proaxis50_35Rl' images are of one product in the Pro Axis bariatric riser recliner range - specialist seating
the 'Proaxis35Rm' images are of one product in the Pro Axis bariatric riser recliner range - specialist seating
the 'Proaxis50_35Rs' images are of one product in the Pro Axis bariatric riser recliner range - specialist seating
the 'Proaxis22_19R' images are of one product in the Pro Axis riser recliner range at 120-140kg user weight - specialist seating
the 'Proaxis22_19R' images are of one product in the Pro Axis riser recliner range at 120-140kg user weight - specialist seating
the Handicare_2395 images are of the ReTurn 7600 (SWL 205kg), a sit-to-stand transfer and repositioning platform with rising ladder and lower-leg supports - a standing and transfer aid
the single 'Mover Aqua 2' image is the product; Mover Aqua is a manual transfer platform / stander on castors for short indoor and bathroom transfers, matching standing and transfer aids
the single 'Bure Double 2 0 1024X1024' image is the product; Bure Double 2.0 is a four-wheel walking frame with twin electric drives for height and width adjustment - a walking aid
the single image is the product; Bure Rise & Go DB is a height-adjustable walking frame with a rise-assist function - a walking aid
the single 'Bure Standard 2 1000X1000' image is the product; this is the standard model of the Bure height-adjustable walking frame range - a walking aid
